newsitem.title: FRANCE: Kohl gives nouvelle cuisine hearty thumbs down.
newsitem.headline: Kohl gives nouvelle cuisine hearty thumbs down.

text.p: As his robust physique suggests, German Chancellor Helmut Kohl has little time for the tiny portions and strawberry-slice decorations of "nouvelle cuisine".

Asked what his favourite French and German foods were, Kohl told France's TF1 television in an interview to be broadcast at seven p.m. (1800 GMT) on Sunday: "I don't have a single favourite dish. As you can see by looking at me, I have too many favourite dishes.

"In France, it's easy: quiche lorraine is one of my favourite foods. In Germany I have a lot of dishes, very simple dishes. But one thing is clear, I am not for 'nouvelle cuisine'. That's quite clear. I prefer more down-to-earth solid food."
